description: This file contains unit tests for the PimCsvDataImport class within the OrangeHRM project. It verifies data import functionality, service interactions, and data validation related to employee CSV import, with specific focus on the PimCsvDataImport class methods.

classes.name: OrangeHRM.Tests.Core\Import\
classes.description: Test class for import functionality of PimCsvDataImport, containing setup and multiple test methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, truncates relevant tables, and instantiates PimCsvDataImport.

methods.name: testGetNationalityService
methods.description: Verifies that getNationalityService returns an instance of NationalityService.

methods.name: testGetCountryService
methods.description: Mocks and tests that getCountryService returns an instance of CountryService.

methods.name: testIsValidPhoneNumber
methods.description: Checks validation logic for phone numbers.

methods.name: testImportWhenSuccessful
methods.description: Tests successful import of employee data with various dependencies mocked.

methods.name: testImportWhenSuccessfulWhenGenderValueChanges
methods.description: Tests import when gender value varies, ensuring correct handling.

methods.name: testFirstNameNotExist
methods.description: Checks behavior when first name is missing; expect failure.

methods.name: testLastNameNotExist
methods.description: Checks behavior when last name is missing; expect failure.

methods.name: testEmployeeIdDuplicated
methods.description: Ensures duplicate employee ID handling prevents re-import.
